title: Enhanced SnO2 Electron Transport Layer by Eu3+ for Efficient and Stable Perovskite Solar Cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Accepted Manuscript

Chemical bath deposition (CBD) is a promising way to fabricate SnO2 electron transport layers (ETLs) in efficient and stable perovskite solar cells (PSCs). Here, europium chloride hexahydrate (EuCl3·6H2O) was introduced...
